title: Towel Bar 18-Inch Solid Brass Wall-Mounted | Antique Brass | Carolina | Allied Brass | Towel Bar Holder Rail Bath | Allied Brass
description:
Stop draping towels over doors and faucets—install a wall-mounted towel bar that keeps daily towels dry, visible, and easy to reach in Antique Brass, which features a softened, aged golden patina that brings vintage charm and character to traditional spaces. This Carolina Collection piece is a bath towel bar that also works as a towel rack or towel holder, bringing traditional bathroom hardware style to classic bath accessories and heritage bathroom fixtures.

Highlights:
- Antique Brass brings warm, timeless elegance
- Coordinates with other Carolina accessories for a curated, collected look
- Choose from 100 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Coordinate the room: part of the Carolina Collection for matching Carolina accessories across the bathroom
- Durable materials: solid brass with brass construction

- Length: 18 Inch
- Overall width: 20

- Weight: 2.4 lbs
